scope.sl: Osvežitev 23. 11. 2026. Številčne ocene in skupna lestvica ostajajo iz zadnjega celotnega ciljnega zajema R3 z dne 20. 11. 2026. Spodaj ločujemo specializirane modele, razvojne rezultate, ki jih poroča njihov avtor, in rezultate celotnih agentnih sistemov. Teh ne mešamo v skupno lestvico posameznih osnovnih modelov, dokler primerljivost in neodvisna pokritost nista ustrezni.
scope.en: Updated 23 Nov 2026. Numeric scores and the overall ranking remain from the latest full targeted R3 capture dated 20 Nov 2026. The items below separate specialized models, developer-reported research results, and complete agent systems. They are not mixed into the single-base-model ranking until comparability and independent coverage are adequate.

summary.sl: Splošno razpoložljiv od 17. 11. 2026. Namenjen je strukturiranim odločitvam, usmerjanju, klasifikaciji in preverjanju z umerjeno stopnjo zaupanja, ne splošnemu klepetu. Microsoft poroča rezultat 68/100 na neodvisnem Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1. Ker ta indeks meri drugačen tip nalog kot naš splošni LLM meta-indeks, model spremljamo ločeno. Microsoft Foundry Global Standard: $0,042 na milijon vhodnih žetonov; izhod je brezplačen.
summary.en: Generally available since 17 Nov 2026. It is designed for structured decisions, routing, classification and verification with calibrated confidence, rather than general chat. Microsoft reports 68/100 on the independently run Artificial Analysis Decision Index v2.1. Because that index measures a different task class from our general LLM meta-index, we track this model separately. Microsoft Foundry Global Standard: $0.042 per million input tokens; output is free.

label.sl: Nov odprtokodni kandidat · čaka na neodvisno potrditev
label.en: New open-weight candidate · awaiting independent validation

summary.sl: RadixArk ga je objavil 18. 11. 2026; temelji na Qwen3.8-27B, uteži so objavljene pod Apache 2.0. Ekipa poroča 12,0 % pass@1 na Terminal-Bench 4.1 v primerjavi s 5,6 % za osnovni Qwen3.8-27B. To je rezultat, ki ga poroča razvijalec, ne neodvisno potrjena primerjalna vrstica na uradni lestvici. Zato ga spremljamo, vendar mu še ne pripisujemo meta-ocene ali mesta.
summary.en: Released by RadixArk on 18 Nov 2026; built on Qwen3.8-27B, with checkpoints under Apache 2.0. The team reports 12.0% pass@1 on Terminal-Bench 4.1 versus 5.6% for the base Qwen3.8-27B. This is a developer-reported result, not an independently validated row on the official leaderboard. We therefore track it but do not assign a meta-score or rank yet.

label.en: System-level result · not a single model

summary.sl: Uradna lestvica Terminal-Bench 4.1 prikazuje 71,2 % ± 2,9 pri uporabi GitHub Copilot agenta. Fusion je sistem za izbiro in koordinacijo modelov; GitHub med razpoložljivimi modeli navaja Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Terra in MAI-Code-2. Rezultat je pomemben za primerjavo agentnih sistemov, ni pa pošteno, da ga vnesemo kot rezultat enega osnovnega LLM-ja v skupno lestvico.
summary.en: The official Terminal-Bench 4.1 leaderboard shows 71.2% ± 2.9 with the GitHub Copilot agent. Fusion is a model-selection and orchestration system; GitHub lists Claude Sonnet 5.5, GPT-6.1 Terra and MAI-Code-2 among the available models. This is important evidence for comparing agent systems, but it should not be entered as the score of one base LLM in the overall ranking.

summary.sl: Arena je uvedla Agent Arena Index in šest ločenih indeksov: Agentic Work, Coding, Chat, Task Outcomes, Tool Use in Steering. Ocene so zdaj sidrane na referenčni nabor modelov; spremenjena je tudi obravnava signalov, med drugim je umaknjen Tool Hallucination. R3 je zajel osvežene Arena podatke do 19. 11. 2026. Stare in nove serije agentnih rezultatov zato primerjamo samo ob upoštevanju različice metodologije.
summary.en: Arena introduced the Agent Arena Index and six focused indexes: Agentic Work, Coding, Chat, Task Outcomes, Tool Use and Steering. Scores are now anchored to a reference set of models; signal handling also changed, including retirement of Tool Hallucination. R3 captured refreshed Arena data through 19 Nov 2026. Old and new agent-result series should therefore be compared only with the methodology version in view.

label.en: Outside the general LLM index scope

summary.sl: 20. 11. 2026 je bil dodan na Arena Text-to-Image lestvico. Gre za model za generiranje slik, zato ga ne vključujemo v primerjavo splošnih besedilnih LLM-jev.
summary.en: Added to Arena's Text-to-Image leaderboard on 20 Nov 2026. It is an image-generation model, so it is not included in the comparison of general-purpose text LLMs.
